definitions.explanation: A cereal grain (Hordeum vulgare) widely cultivated for food and brewing. In Japan, barley is used to make mugicha (barley tea), shochu, miso, and various foods.

examples.japanese: {大麦|おおむぎ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Barley tea is made from barley.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大麦|おおむぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
examples.english: Barley cultivation is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: {大麦|おおむぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食物繊維|しょくもつせんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Barley is said to be healthy because it is rich in dietary fiber.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
{大麦|おおむぎ} (barley) vs ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧ (wheat): Despite the names using {大|おお} (big) and ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small), the distinction is not about size. {大麦|おおむぎ} is barley and ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧ is wheat — two different grains. ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧ alone is a general term for cereal grains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大麦|おおむぎ}{茶|ちゃ}: barley tea (same as ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧)
- {大麦|おおむぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧: barley cultivation
- {大麦|おおむぎ}⟦{若葉|わかば}→若葉：19659_wakaba⟧: young barley grass (health supplement)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Barley has been cultivated in Japan since ancient times. It is a key ingredient in ⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧ (barley tea, a staple summer drink), ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧みそ (barley miso), and ⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧ (barley shochu).
